headline: Yape Wins Historic Virtual Taekwondo Gold as PH Haul Reaches 28 Medals
seoTitle: Yape Wins Historic Asian Games Gold; PH Reaches 28 Medals | FMB News
seoDescription: Jeus Yape won the first Asian Games mixed virtual taekwondo title as the Philippines reached four golds and 28 total medals.
deck: Yape delivered the Philippines’ fourth gold; later results lifted the delegation to 4 golds, 8 silvers and 16 bronzes with competition still continuing.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape won the first Asian Games mixed individual virtual taekwondo title in Toyohashi, giving the Philippines its fourth gold of the Aichi-Nagoya Games. The Olympic Council of Asia says Yape defeated Vietnam’s Chau Ngoc Tuyet Sang 2-0, winning the two rounds by Remaining HP scores of 500-0 and 620-0.

By late Friday, the Philippine tally had risen to four golds, eight silvers and 16 bronzes, or 28 medals. GMA News reported that total as the country’s best Asian Games output since 1966, although events were still in progress.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Yape’s gold is a final medal result. Tachiana Mangin and Kurt Barbosa won taekwondo silvers, Carlo Paalam finished with boxing silver, Annie Ramirez took jiu-jitsu bronze and the women’s beach-volleyball team added bronze.
Paalam had earlier been assured at least bronze after reaching the semifinal. His October 2 final upgraded that guaranteed medal to silver after a 2-3 split-decision loss to Japan’s Rui Yamaguchi.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Yape’s title is the first gold awarded in the Asian Games’ mixed individual virtual taekwondo event and pushed the Philippines beyond its Hangzhou overall medal count.
The broader medal surge shows gains across taekwondo, boxing, jiu-jitsu and beach volleyball, while keeping the distinction clear between qualification, an assured medal and a completed final result.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The 28-medal count was current late October 2, not the final delegation total. Padel, softball, rhythmic gymnastics, golf and other events could still change it.

verificationNotes: The Olympic Council of Asia’s official report confirms Yape’s inaugural mixed individual virtual taekwondo gold, his opponent and the 2-0 result.
GMA’s late-October 2 roundup reports a 4-8-16 Philippine tally, 28 medals in total, with events still continuing.
GMA separately confirms Paalam’s silver after a 2-3 split decision; the article clearly distinguishes his earlier assured bronze from the final medal.
